highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Fanshawe College is a leading post-secondary institution located in Ontario, Canada, where you can get an excellent hands-on, career-focused education. If you’re passionate about the creative and performing arts, Fanshawe offers a range of specialised programs in Theatre Arts, Music Industry Arts, Broadcasting, and more.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At Fanshawe, you'll become part of a diverse and welcoming community, with fellow students from around the globe. You'll have access to a variety of services, including counselling and health services. The Fanshawe Student Union (FSU) makes your college time better by organising events, clubs, wellness initiatives, and more.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Fanshawe College offers a variety of on-campus housing options. Fanshawe's traditional apartment-style residences consist of three buildings: Falcon, Peregrine, and Merlin House. You’ll get access to several amenities like laundry facilities, maintenance services, study lounges, common lounges, activity lounges with games, and more.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Fanshawe College Library provides you with spaces for studying and research. Plus, you can access computers in the Library Learning Commons for academic purposes.

Sports
Fanshawe College offers a comprehensive range of sports and recreational activities. You can participate in badminton, ball hockey, basketball, cricket, soccer, table tennis, and volleyball. Plus, you can make use of the Fitness Centre, which offers spaces for cardio and strength training.

Laboratory
Fanshawe College is equipped with specialised laboratories tailored to various academic programs. These labs provide hands-on learning experiences. Some of these include the Simulation labs, Fanshawe's Centre for Applied Research and Innovation in Biotechnology, and more.

Cafeteria
The campus offers diverse dining facilities, such as the Oasis, The Out Back Shack, Booster Juice, and many more. Also in the Student Union Building, you have the Nest, which offers snacks, beverages, and quick eats.
